Claim amendment 1 on #30206 · 2026-11-05T14:18Z

The dev's check of 「中国」 in 默认国家 found the refusal starts in the console. `SettingsField.tsx`'s `DomainCombobox` swaps typed text for the option's code only when the text equals the option label (「中国 (CN)」 in the zh pack) or the code, so 「中国」 is submitted as typed. The server then refuses it with `invalid_format` (`packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts`, pattern `^[A-Za-z]{2}$`), whose message is not localized.

File surface grows by the console half: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx` (a typed country name resolves to its code) and the settings view that renders field errors (a refusal with code `invalid_format` is drawn from the console's own localized text), with their tests. ⛔ `packages/**` stays out: the server's pattern check is correct as it is, and the console reading the error by code is what localizes it, so no server card is filed for this item.
